title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
abstract: arXiv:2610.32755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record

translated_title: 面向自动化实验室中智能体自我博弈的语义表示
translated_abstract: 驾驭复杂、高维的生物搜索空间需要可扩展的物理与计算智能，以便通过在构思、实验和自动化之间的迭代式自我博弈，探索超越局部最优的方案。将实验设计转化为可靠的物理执行仍然受制于静态的实验室自动化和未建模的物理变异性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories（简称VERID），这是一个旨在弥合人工智能（AI）智能体高层推理与湿实验室复杂、易出错的物理现实之间差距的基础性基础设施。VERID是实验室工作单元的持久化、高保真语义数字孪生体，提供四项核心服务：用于智能体推理的可查询自省、用于方案验证的时间压缩仿真、用于完整科学记录的全面追踪持久化。
tldr: 该论文提出VERID——实验室工作单元的持久化高保真语义数字孪生基础设施，通过可查询自省、时间压缩仿真与全面追踪持久化等核心服务，弥合AI智能体高层推理与湿实验室复杂易错物理现实之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VERID, a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that bridges the gap between AI agents' high-level reasoning and the complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs through core services such as queryable introspection, time-compressed simulation, and comprehensive trace persistence.
